# A09-S15: Press strategy

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Yep, it just needed a good press release. Super cool to see it works. Now I have to try to keep the momentum - that part about actually running the party is completely new to me, and a bit scary! Let me know if you can afford to hire me a social media manager and a press chief, haha 😂

I googled him from Google now, and it looks a bit like he is a religious nutcase! I would also say that they precisely are not conscious - the issue is much more dangerous: they are stupid!

We'll talk soon! Please feel free to send me more if anything comes your way.
